title: A small fund publishes its own scorecard
text:
Six years on, a small fund publishes its own scorecard.

Foundry Seed has published a retrospective on its 2019 vintage, an unusual document for a firm of its size: eighteen companies, four write-offs named, and a paragraph on each about what the firm got wrong.

Sil Vantorre, who led the fund, writes that the worst decision was reserving nothing for follow-on rounds, and that two of the four write-offs would have survived a second cheque.

The retrospective went up on 9 December 2025. Vantorre says the firm will publish one for every fund it raises, while it still costs something to do it.

Other investors in Austin have not rushed to copy the format.
